name: keepkeys
description: Paste local secrets into the native OS vault and let your agent use them through approval-gated commands.

interface.shortDescription: Local secrets for approved agent commands
interface.longDescription: KeepKeys lets the agent prepare names, variables, descriptions, providers, and official documentation links. You press Paste & Store to put the clipboard value directly into the operating-system credential vault, then approve each command that may use it. Secret values are never returned to the model.
capabilities: Native macOS, Windows, and Linux vaults
defaultPrompt: Store a new secret with KeepKeys.
Use a KeepKeys secret for this command.
